pages.name: Benko Gambit: 4.Nf3 g6 5.cxb5 a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Black playing ...bxa6 with no b-pawn; plan 4 wrote castling as 0-0; plans 2-3 tightened (queen and knight routes). Rewrote all four plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Zaitsev System
pages.notes: Overview called 5.Nc3 a solid move reinforcing the centre; it prepares e2-e4 and Nb5 after 5...axb5. Plan 2 suggested Nd2 with no knight able to reach it; rewritten around 6.e4 b4 7.Nb5. British spelling in plan 1.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Zaitsev, 5...axb5
pages.notes: Plan 1 called the g7-bishop light-squared and named queen moves as pawn moves; plans 2 and 4 rewritten around 6.e4 b4 7.Nb5 (plan 4 had an aimless d5-d6 break). British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 5.bxa6 g6
pages.notes: Plan 2 named d4 as a Black target square read as a move; rewritten around ...Bxa6, ...d6, ...Nbd7. Plan 3 claimed a pawn-return idea with a7 the reviewer could not confirm; rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Accepted, 6.g3 d6 7.Bg2 g6
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the f6-knight straight to b6; rewritten with ...Nbd7 and the knight to b6 or e5. British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Accepted, 7.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Nb6 with no route; plan 4 claimed g3/Bg2 challenges the g7-bishop (different diagonal); rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Accepted, 7.Nf3 g6 8.Nd2 Qa5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the bishop already on g7 and read the e4 break as a Black move; plan 2 claimed e4 challenges the g7-bishop. Rewrote both; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Fianchetto, 9.Bg2
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Rfb8 before castling and with the queen on d8; rewritten with ...O-O and ...Qa5 first. British spelling in overview and plans 2-3.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: Fianchetto, 9.Bh3
pages.notes: Overview and plans 1, 3, 4 had the light-squared h3-bishop exchanging on g7, which is impossible. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 3, 4 around Bh3 watching d7 and c8; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Benko Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent knights to c5 or b6 without a route; plan 2 suggested Ra1 with the rook already there. Rewrote both plans.
